objective: Make authoritative state changes atomic with restart-safe tamper-evident evidence.
authorized_legacy_refs: Gen 1 audit hash chain and tests
deliverable_refs: Append/mutation API, transactional stream heads, verifier, checkpoint and independent-anchor interfaces.
FULL/PARTIAL/FAILED verification results and complete artifact inventory checks.
Threat model and explicit local-versus-independent proof levels.
required_test_refs: Concurrent append, transaction rollback, edit/delete/reorder/truncation and corrupt object tests.
Fault between domain write/evidence/outbox cannot commit partial authority.
Independent-checkpoint fixture detects coordinated local rollback; incomplete scan never passes.
acceptance_gate: All defined attacker/fault cases yield the specified verdict; real anchoring remains an activation dependency.
